scope: Read-only source and build-integration audit; this is not a physical timing, bitstream, or full functional pass.

method.source_match: Compared all 136 scoped committed production entries: 134 blobs are identical to 7b0. The exact new Linear and Multiply blobs were fetched and hashed. After removing comments and whitespace, their deltas match only the specified bank-selection FIFO stage and the two optional DSP operand defaults. No fresh local checkout match is claimed while the execution workspace is unavailable.
method.baseline_comparison: Original-main findings, all parameter/value proofs and reset/handshake reasoning are retained where source blobs remain unchanged. New production changes only separate the affine bank selection and remove invalid-cycle operand defaults.
method.build_review: Reviewed Sway hw/Makefile, physical checker, reset transformation, workflow and pinned blueYosys build.mk, board.mk and ulx3s.lpf.
method.execution: Read-only committed-source review and independent remote inspection of the downloaded focused native artifact. The CI native test passed on three simulation backends. Full candidate functional and physical CI was still in progress when this audit was prepared.

source_match.scope: Committed production-source identity and reviewed delta

unchanged_from_baseline.meaning: Numerical formats and arithmetic helpers, dimensions and lane settings, frozen model and scales, software model, UART/clock wrapper, and golden fixtures remain unchanged.

generated_parameters.note: Convolution lookup encoding changed earlier and was checked over 640 lookups. Current linearBias encoding changed to 512-bit truth planes and passed all 5632 configured-layer row addresses plus 1536 unknown-layer defaults; all 177 trained bias values also matched frozen exported tensors. Across the latest change, 372 of 373 parameter functions are byte-identical and every affine ROM file hash is unchanged.

architecture.note: Engines and per-lane multipliers remain dedicated. Pipeline and storage changes retain the arithmetic sequence; no model substitution, engine sharing, clock reduction, or test-only numerical shortcut was found.

build_integration.dependency_note: GNU Make combines Sway's prerequisites with the included build rules. .NOTPARALLEL serializes them. Runtime RTL and ROM copies complete before Yosys; reset folding completes after mapping and before the pnr recipe. The chain is a dependency summary, not an assertion that every target has only one prerequisite.

corrected_metadata.history_note: The retained implementationMetadataRefresh names f66 for the earlier two-cycle weight-ROM description correction; linearBiasCoefficientValidation records this subsequent encoding-only change.

remaining_acceptance: Actual strict physical result for 439 at 100 MHz core and 25 MHz UART remains authoritative; this audit does not assert a physical pass.
Fresh candidate-matched stress/kernel results for divisors 1, 2 and 4 and in-flight warm-reset evidence must be collected.
ecppack must succeed with a nonempty bitstream and independently checked SHA256.
Final independent artifact acceptance must check complete candidate physical and functional ZIPs; only the native ZIP has been independently downloaded and verified so far.
evidence_notes: physical/report.json is finalized before ecppack and the summary step; its evidence_sha256 does not cover later mkTop.bit, bitstream.sha256 or timing_summary.json. A final evidence manifest should cover those outputs explicitly.
Final documentation should identify divisor 4 as the physical scope and divisors 1/2/4 as the functional scope, preserving historical arithmetic/model proof provenance.
No physical-board programming or operation is claimed.

The candidate native workflow's original symbol-absence regex did not include dollar identifiers. Independent inspection found a retained aWire$whas used for validity/credits, while both operand assignments were direct ROM-data slices. A corrected continuous-assignment cone check passed and preserves that validity signal. Final workflow/auditor should use operand-cone independence, not global WHAS absence.

affine_bank_selection.exact_delta: Add bankQ normal two-entry FIFO and process2_bank that atomically consumes selectQ and stores tuple(selected[bank], lastInput). process2_1 now consumes bankQ and enqueues that tuple into readQ; all other noncomment code is unchanged.
affine_bank_selection.mapping: Selected INT8 operand and final-column flag are exactly the same expressions previously used by process2_1. No address, signedness, scale, lane, product or arithmetic change.
affine_bank_selection.ordering_and_credits: Selection is buffered before a ROM request. ROM address advancement, four-slot reservation and read-valid assertion remain atomic only with bankQ dequeue, all lane ROM requests and readQ enqueue. FIFO order preserves input/weight alignment. The two-cycle ROM latency and capture rules are unchanged.
affine_bank_selection.row_completion: Final-product dequeue implies the last input has passed selectQ, bankQ, ROM metadata and product queues. Earlier entries cannot remain behind the final flag. Row restart therefore cannot reuse an old bankQ entry; a token remains active until its final affine result.
affine_bank_selection.reset: bankQ resets empty; existing issue/active/valid/counter resets retain their previous behavior. Invalid data is never promoted to a valid request.
affine_bank_selection.latency_scope: A registered selection stage is added. Exact schedules, cycles and achieved physical timing require fresh candidate CI; no latency total or timing pass is inferred.

dsp_operand_defaults.exact_delta: Only aWire and bWire defaults inside mkMultiply change from 0 to ?. Raw model defaults, validWire default 0, validR length/reset, DSP configuration, eight-result reservation and capture/get logic are unchanged.
dsp_operand_defaults.safety: The DSP advances every cycle and computes independent products. Only the corresponding three-stage validity bit permits capture. Values computed from invalid-cycle operands are unobservable; subsequent accepted operands have no arithmetic dependence on them. Reset clears validity and FIFO state.
dsp_operand_defaults.all_call_sites: Linear, normalization, convolution, gating and scan put operands are FIFO .first values and pure arithmetic. No put operand originates from an ActionValue result in that same rule.

compiler_review.finding: PreludeBSV mkDWire returns the written value or the supplied default. ADropUndet fixes PrimIf expressions with an undetermined branch to the other branch when it contains no ActionValue/task result, even without aggressive undefined-value optimization. No global undefined-value compiler flag was added.

native_evidence.limitation: Focused fixed-configuration simulation and generated-RTL inspection; no full-system timing or physical-board claim.

docs_review.finding: Documents the registered bank-selection FIFO, unchanged four ROM credits/two-cycle ROM pipeline, and validity-qualified unspecified DSP operands.

sum_fifo.exact_delta: sumQ changes from mkLFIFO to mkFIFO1, plus two explanatory comment lines; all arithmetic and remaining code are identical.
sum_fifo.ordering: The single FIFO entry retains both the complete row sum and its group index. A full sumQ stalls process3Last atomically, retaining the final product and accumulator until enqueue succeeds. process4 dequeues only when affineQ accepts. Removing simultaneous full-entry replacement can add a bubble under backpressure but cannot reorder or drop results.
sum_fifo.reset: Both implementations reset FIFO validity. Existing activeOn, counters and metadata reset paths are unchanged.
sum_fifo.purpose: Registered enqueue readiness prevents affineQ readiness from reaching row-completion controls in the same cycle.

patch_selection.exact_delta: Adds patchSelectQ mkFIFO1, replaces process3's 16-way patch selection with four column-selected row vectors, and adds process3_1 to select the row and enqueue embedding. All other code is identical.

static_mapping.method: Static address-expression enumeration in JavaScript, not RTL simulation
static_mapping.scale_operation: Both expressions retain the identical requant32(signExtend(frameR[address]), nodeScale("input"), nodeScale("patches")) call.

patch_selection.ordering: patchSelectQ stores the full four-bit token index and all four selected row vectors. patchCnt advances, or patchOn clears for the last token, only with successful enqueue. process3_1 dequeues atomically with embedding.put; a stalled embedding therefore retains the exact index and payload. FIFO order preserves token order.
patch_selection.frame_transition: After the last patch is queued, the next frame may load while that patch waits. The queued payload is self-contained and no longer reads frameR, so overwriting frameR cannot affect the pending patch. A full queue blocks the next frame's patch issue.
patch_selection.reset: The new FIFO resets empty. Existing patchOn=False, patchCnt=0 and input/frame FIFO resets prevent stale or uninitialized frame data from becoming valid after reset.
patch_selection.timing_scope: The static review establishes mapping and handshake intent; actual schedules, full outputs, warm reset, and timing remain the candidate CI's responsibility.

affine_bias.delta: Only linearBias changed from signed word case tables to eight constant 512-bit truth planes per biased layer, addressed with the existing nine-bit row.
affine_bias.behavior: All signed INT8 values and zero defaults are identical. No state, latency, handshake, arithmetic width, multiplier or lane change is introduced.
affine_bias.synthesis_purpose: Avoid case-derived word ROM inference and address-register absorption by Yosys memory_dff. Fresh physical timing remains authoritative.

output_counter.delta: Only outputCnt changes from mkReg(0) to mkRegU, plus an initialization comment; all other noncomment code is identical.
output_counter.ordering_and_reset: Reset holds outputOn false, making inactive outputCnt unobservable. process8 initializes outputCnt to zero in the same atomic rule that sets outputOn true, before any process9 read can occur. Stalls retain the current index; accepted bytes advance or clear outputOn exactly as before.
output_counter.proof_limit: Abstract serializer-counter equivalence; fresh full RTL and in-flight warm reset remain required.

findings: mkFIFO wraps mkFIFOF_ with implicit full/empty guards.
mkFIFOF_ uses the depth-two FIFO2 primitive, with registered FULL_N and conflict-free enqueue/dequeue.
The replaced one-entry loopy FIFO explicitly declares the DEQ-to-FULL_N combinational path.

affine_product_fifo.exact_delta: productQ changes from mkLFIFO to mkFIFO with explanatory comments; all other noncomment source is identical.
affine_product_fifo.capacity: The normal mkFIFO is two entries. Registered FULL_N removes the dequeue-to-enqueue readiness path; simultaneous enqueue/dequeue remains possible at occupancy one.
affine_product_fifo.ordering: Each entry carries every lane's product and its lastInput flag as a single tuple. process2_4 atomically consumes ordered product metadata and all DSP results only when productQ can enqueue. process3 and process3Last consume FIFO order, retaining all earlier products before the final product.
affine_product_fifo.credits: The multiplier's eight reserved result slots and counters are unchanged. A full productQ postpones the atomic DSP get and credit release; each outstanding DSP capture still owns its reserved slot. The extra product buffer stores an already-consumed DSP result and does not consume unreserved DSP capacity.
affine_product_fifo.row_completion: process3Last still combines the final product with the accumulator and atomically enqueues the completed row before resetting the accumulator, changing group metadata and requesting restart. Next-row issue still follows rowStartQ. A full productQ cannot allow the last flag to overtake data or restart a row early.
affine_product_fifo.reset: Both FIFO entries become invalid on reset. Existing multiplier-valid, result, metadata and active/control resets are unchanged; no stale entry is observable after reset.
affine_product_fifo.timing_scope: The source removes the exact combinational readiness dependency identified in b21's10.094ns path. Full current CI establishes schedules, outputs, warm reset and actual timing.
